info.title: FDIC Universal API
info.description: Access FDIC BankFind Suite public banking data for insured institutions, branch locations, structure history, financials, summary data, failures, Summary of Deposits, and demographics.

get.description: Retrieves failed bank records from FDIC.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Elastic Search query string filter for bank failure records, for example FAILYR:2023.

schema.description: Elastic Search query string filter for bank failure records, for example FAILYR:2023.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-delimited uppercase FDIC fields to include in the response.

schema.description: Comma-delimited uppercase FDIC fields to include in the response.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of records to skip before returning results.

parameters.name: where
parameters.description: An RSQL expression used to filter the results.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Fields to sort by, with an optional direction for each field.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
